items.title: Sidney "Jim Little" Brown Interview, 1960-05-27
items.q: Oh, I played several jobs with him.

ctx.x: Did you ever play with him up here?
Oh, I played several jobs with him.
What kind of a band did he have then? Oh, no, not much of a band. I mean did they play arrangements and read music or just head? Oh yeah, they would read. They would read.
